children: Contango reported high-grade drill intercepts at Kitsault Valley, including 506 g/t AgEq over 13.90 m at Torbrit and 807 g/t AgEq over 4.96 m at North Star.
Announced initial assays from 34 holes: DV26-480 hit 506 g/t AgEq over 13.90 m at Torbrit.
North Star drill DV26-494 returned 807 g/t AgEq over 4.96 m, including 2,254 g/t AgEq over 1.00 m.
Step-out drilling confirmed a mineralized corridor linking Torbrit and North Star, indicating an interconnected silver system.
2026 program expanded to >50,000 m (from 40,000 m) due to operational efficiencies; majority of assays remain pending.
Results to be incorporated into updated geological model and will feed into upcoming 2026 MRE update and 2027 MRE planning.
